claims.quote: The machine, which was very light and operated entirely by electricity, was built of metal throughout; it shot up into the air with terrific speed and then took a northeasterly direction at a rate of ten miles per minute, or 600 miles per hour.
claims.description: Electric all-metal air taxis that take off vertically and fly at 600 miles per hour.

claims.quote: These National Playgrounds were built by the city in 2490, at the extreme eastern end of what used to be Long Island, a few miles from Montauk.
claims.description: A huge municipal sports and recreation complex built at the eastern tip of Long Island.

claims.quote: The City Government supplied all the various sport paraphernalia and every citizen has the right to use it, by applying to the lieutenants in charge of the various sections.
claims.description: Free publicly supplied sports equipment available to every citizen.

claims.quote: It never rains, it is never too hot, it is never too cold.
claims.description: Weather control over a large outdoor area so that it never rains and stays temperate.

claims.quote: After sunset, the grounds and fields are lighted by thousands of iridium wire spirals, for those who have to work in the daytime.
claims.description: Floodlit sports fields for night play.

claims.quote: As a matter of fact all the great baseball, tennis, and football contests are held after sundown.
claims.description: Major sporting contests are played at night under artificial lighting for fairness.

claims.quote: Underneath the heavy plate glass squares were the photo-electric elements which transformed the solar heat *direct* into electric energy.
claims.description: A vast solar farm of photoelectric cells converting sunlight directly into electricity.

claims.quote: A small electric motor inside of the tripod moved the metal case so as to keep the plates always facing the sun.
claims.description: Motorized sun-tracking mounts that keep solar panels facing the sun all day.

claims.quote: In order that one case might not take away the light from the one directly behind it, all cases were arranged in long rows, each sufficiently far away from the one preceding it.
claims.description: Solar panel rows spaced to avoid shading one another.

claims.quote: In fact, this plant supplied all the power, light, and heat for entire New York.
claims.description: A single solar power plant supplying all the power, light and heat for a great city.

claims.quote: One-half of the plant was for day use, while the other half during daytime charged the chemical gas-accumulators for night use.
claims.description: Grid energy storage: half the solar output charges chemical accumulators for use at night.

claims.quote: Since that time inventors by the score had busied themselves to perfect solar generators, but it was not until the year 2469 that the Italian 63A 1243 invented the photo-electric cell, which revolutionized the entire electrical industry.
claims.description: Invention of an efficient photoelectric cell that revolutionizes the electrical industry.

claims.quote: This Italian discovered that by derivatives of the Radium-M class, in conjunction with Tellurium and Arcturium, a photo-electric element could be produced which was strongly affected by the sun's ultra-violet rays and in this condition was able to transform heat *direct* into electrical energy, without losses of any kind.
claims.description: A lossless photoelectric material made from radium derivatives, tellurium and a new element, arcturium.

claims.quote: Thus a partial vacuum is produced above the plant and the air consequently is very thin.
claims.description: Giant towers that thin the atmosphere above a solar plant to increase the energy it collects.

claims.quote: The result was that all objects on the distant stage of the National Opera were projected full size on the composite Telephot plates on the Tele-Theater stage.
claims.description: Live television broadcast of theater onto a full-size home screen made of tiled display panels.

claims.quote: These telephots were connected in series and were all joined together so cleverly that no break or joint was visible in the rear part of the stage.
claims.description: Multiple display panels joined seamlessly into one large video wall.

claims.quote: He inserted one of the plugs into a hole labeled "National Opera." He then manipulated several levers and switches and seated himself again with his guests.
claims.description: A home switchboard for tuning in to a chosen live performance.

claims.quote: Between the acts Ralph explained that each New York playhouse now had over 200,000 subscribers and it was as easy for the Berlin and Paris subscribers to hear and see the play as for the New York subscriber.
claims.description: Subscription broadcasting of plays to hundreds of thousands of viewers, including across the Atlantic.

claims.quote: They probably would have rejoiced at the ease of our Tele-Theaters, where we can switch from one play to another in five seconds, until we find the one that suits us best.
claims.description: Channel-switching between live broadcast shows in seconds.

claims.quote: Nor could their sick people enjoy themselves seeing a play, as we can now.
claims.description: Bedridden people can watch plays at home through broadcast entertainment.

claims.quote: Later, when it was all over, they went down to the street floor at Ralph's suggestion, where they put on their Tele-motor-coasters, preparatory to seeing more of New York—this time by night.
claims.description: Powered roller skates used for personal street travel.

claims.quote: This light moreover was absolutely cold, as all electrical energy was transformed into light, none being lost in heat.
claims.description: Perfectly efficient cold electric lighting that wastes no energy as heat.

claims.quote: Despite the fact that it was 11 o'clock at night, the streets were almost as light as at noonday.
claims.description: Every street and alley lit almost as brightly as day at night.

claims.quote: James 212B 422, as well as his daughter, lingered over the superb displays in the various stores and they entered several to make a few purchases.
claims.description: People identified by alphanumeric codes as their surnames.

claims.quote: It made the box to suit the size of the final package, placed the articles together, packed them into the box which was not yet finished, folded the box after the handle had been stamped out, stenciled the firm's name on two sides and delivered it completely packed, all within ten to fifteen seconds.
claims.description: Automatic packing machines that measure the goods, make a custom-sized box and pack it in seconds.

claims.quote: Moreover, it was made of *Alohydrolium*, which is the lightest of all metals, being one-eighth the weight of aluminum.
claims.description: A new magnetic metal one-eighth the weight of aluminum.

claims.quote: It was carried down into the *Packet-Post Conveyor*, which was from seventy-five to one hundred feet below the level of the street, where it landed on a belt-like arrangement moving at the rate of five miles an hour.
claims.description: An underground conveyor-belt parcel post network running beneath city streets.

claims.quote: The action was entirely automatic and the chute was arranged with an automatic shutter which would only open when there was no package immediately below on the moving belt.
claims.description: Automatic chute gating that prevents parcels from piling up on the conveyor.

claims.quote: This contact arrangement closed the circuit of a powerful electromagnet placed in the same line with the contact, a few feet away from the express belt.
claims.description: Automated parcel sorting in which a height-coded rider trips a contact and an electromagnet pulls the parcel off at the right station.

claims.quote: On arriving at the correct address its rider would strike the contact overhead, which operated the electromagnet, pulling the package into the basement of the house, where it fell on the platform of an electric dumb-waiter.
claims.description: Fully automatic parcel delivery into each house through its basement and an electric dumb-waiter.

claims.quote: By this method a package could be delivered in the average space of forty minutes from the time of purchase.
claims.description: Same-hour delivery of store purchases, averaging forty minutes.

claims.quote: You haven't much time," the man answered, "at 12 o'clock all cabs must be out of the air.
claims.description: Legal closure of city airspace to air traffic during public events.

claims.quote: Thousands of aerial craft, their powerful searchlights sweeping the skies, moved silently through the night, and once in a while an immense transatlantic aerial liner would swish by at a tremendous speed.
claims.description: Dense night air traffic over the city, including transatlantic airliners.

claims.quote: These are powerful searchlights of the most advanced type, mounted on special buildings.
claims.description: Color-coded vertical searchlight beacons that let aircraft identify landing piers from far away.

claims.quote: No aerial craft is allowed to cross these light shafts.
claims.description: Air traffic rules forbidding aircraft to cross beacon light shafts.

claims.quote: Even an aerial liner at sea can recognize the signal and steer directly into the Herald Square pier, without being obliged to hover over the city in search of it.
claims.description: Aerial liners docking at piers inside the city, guided in by beacons.

claims.quote: It was composed of 6,000 flyers, all together in the same horizontal plane.
claims.description: Night sky light show made by thousands of coordinated lighted aircraft forming images such as a flag.

claims.quote: The carnival closed with a light-picture of the Planet Governor.
claims.description: A single world government headed by a Planet Governor.

claims.quote: The rays emanating from the cathode, when the tube was energized with high oscillatory currents, were called *Arcturium Rays* and would instantly destroy any bacilli exposed to them for a few seconds.
claims.description: A radiation chamber whose rays kill all germs in seconds.

claims.quote: It was found, however, that by filtering arcturium rays through helium no burns would result, but any germ or bacillus in or on the body would be killed at once.
claims.description: Filtering the rays through helium makes them safe for people while still killing germs inside the body.

claims.quote: The Bacillatorium was prescribed by law and each citizen ordered to use it at least every other day, thus making it impossible for the human body to develop contagious diseases.
claims.description: Legally mandated germ-killing treatment every other day for all citizens.

claims.quote: The Bacillatorium eradicated such diseases.
claims.description: Contagious germ-borne diseases are eradicated.

claims.quote: The arcturium rays, moreover, had a highly beneficial effect on animal tissue and the enforced use of the Bacillatorium extended the span of human life to between one hundred and twenty and one hundred and forty years, where in former centuries three score and ten was the average.
claims.description: Human lifespan extended to 120 to 140 years.

claims.quote: When, about the year 2600, the population of the planet had increased tremendously and famines due to lack of such essentials as bread and potatoes had broken out in many parts of the world, it was found vitally necessary to produce such necessities on a larger scale and with unfailing regularity.
claims.description: Global overpopulation and widespread famine forcing industrial-scale food production.

claims.quote: These farms became known under the term of Accelerated Plant Growing Farms and were located in every part of the world.
claims.description: Enormous greenhouse farms for staple crops built all over the world.

claims.quote: Ralph took the existing hothouses, which were simply oblong steel and glass boxes, and built a second hothouse box covering each of them, thus creating a double-walled, air-locked hothouse.
claims.description: Double-walled insulated greenhouses that trap heat through the night.

claims.quote: One of these hothouses is about three miles long and the same width.
claims.description: Greenhouses three miles on a side.

claims.quote: Where Mother Nature used to grow one crop of wheat a year, Ralph's latest Accelerator made it possible to grow four, and sometimes five crops a year.
claims.description: Accelerated agriculture producing four or five wheat harvests a year.

claims.quote: We found it economic, therefore, to use the earth's own heat to heat our farms.
claims.description: Geothermal heating of greenhouse farms.

claims.quote: By means of high speed drills, we can cut a three-foot shaft 3,000 feet deep in the earth in less than a month.
claims.description: High-speed drilling of deep geothermal shafts in under a month.

claims.quote: Then we lower steel tanks into the cavity and run pipes up to the surface.
claims.description: A closed-loop geothermal hot-water circulation system with buried tanks and pipes.

claims.quote: Thus the temperature of our farms is uniform all the year around and plant growth is as rapid during the night as during the day.
claims.description: Year-round constant greenhouse temperature giving continuous day-and-night plant growth.

claims.quote: The Termidon immediately turns the soil into a rich, dark strata, the best soil for potatoes, wheat, or corn.
claims.description: A sprayed chemical fertilizer that instantly turns soil rich and greatly speeds crop growth.

claims.quote: This liquid Termidon is sprayed over the entire length and breadth of the field before planting time, so that the soil becomes well soaked.
claims.description: Automated overhead spraying of fertilizer across entire indoor fields.
